name: husband-rain-cold-personal
prompt: Precise clothing edit for an EXISTING Android character, NOT a redesign. Image 1 is the authoritative original pose sheet to edit. Image 2 is the approved identity/style master. Image 3 is the original outfit/umbrella design reference only. Produce EXACTLY 12 separate full-body figures in a 4-column 3-row grid, EXACT SAME POSES, same expressions, facing directions and cell order as image 1. Adult man: original receding temples, swept short brown hair, thin round black glasses, small moustache, POINTED DARK GOATEE and fine cheek stubble in EVERY expression, narrow angular nose and eyebrows. Facial hair must be as visible as in original sprites. ANATOMY REQUIREMENT: exactly TWO arms and TWO hands per figure, matching image 1. The umbrella is hands-free, attached behind the shoulder, not held. No extra hand, no third arm. Change ONLY wardrobe to his original cream dinosaur hoodie with a plain hood UP, black trousers and detailed white sneakers; no scarf, no animal ears. Integrate the original muted sage green umbrella in each figure, canopy directly above and near the head, the shaft is attached to a tiny back-mounted clip and passes BEHIND the shoulder. BOTH original hands and arms perform exactly the original pose. Absolutely NO hand grips the umbrella.  Preserve the original illustration's detailed soft cel shading, fine warm dark outlines, face/body proportions, textured hair, warm skin tone, visible clothing seams, shoes and adult likeness. Do not simplify into tiny generic cartoon, toddler, flat vector, round baby face, emoji or toy. No changes to faces to suit the outfit. Preserve ALL animation phases, no substituting repetitive idle poses. Equal head size across cells; never shrink sitting figures. Give each complete figure generous gutters and outer margins; no overlap/cropping. No text, labels, grid lines, scenery or floor shadow. Background MUST be one perfectly uniform FLAT PURE CYAN RGB(0,255,255) #00FFFF for automated alpha extraction, including holes between arms/legs. NO checkerboard, gradient, glow, cyan rimlight or cyan clothing. Keep dark neutral clean antialiased edges, no coloured outline. Request 2048x1536 high-detail PNG. The exact original identity and render style take priority over ornamental additions. CRITICAL: maintain the same outfit in EVERY pose: hot means SHORT sleeves and bare legs below shorts, including seated/stretched poses; night means a proper button-up pajama collar and button placket, no hoodie, no drawstrings. All umbrellas are hands-free, no hand on the pole. Do not copy extra umbrella-holding hands. Both arms retain their original gesture. Count exactly two hands per figure before finishing.
